verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an online employer portal like eServices/EAMS could plausibly offer event-triggered rules, such as automatic filings or actions on account events. However, the evidence only covers manual online or paper filing, appeals, account setup and penalty waivers. Nothing shows user-defined rules, triggers or automated actions, and probes found no API, OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
